scope: Tracked and untracked captured-framing implementation against HEAD, plus the Camera target-picker correction.
method: Three independent read-only reviewers; parent implemented and triaged corrections. Reviewers did not run Cargo or GUI checks.

reviewers.scope: Core and store admission, legacy grammar and migration
reviewers.result: No remaining findings after two corrections and follow-up review.

reviewers.scope: Plan, renderer and Metal qualification harness
Native pause capture, picture propagation and Camera keyboard routing

findings.problem: Typed incoming contexts in recipes, subtrees and patches were copied before validation.
findings.fix: Shared command/occurrence payload preflight, bounded subtree admission, virtual resulting patch validation and cumulative isolation-copy checks.

findings.problem: Clearing a repeated occurrence's context at the aggregate limit rejected its temporary isolation copy even though the final result was within the limit.
findings.fix: Private isolation validation allows two document budgets in that intermediate state; the final result and public validation remain at 100,000 records.
findings.limit: The cap applies to each private intermediate document, not all simultaneous input, snapshot and transaction allocations.

parent_corrections: Retain an empty captured stage's implicit clip when appending a pose, and compact only redundant identity clips.
Apply a canvas fit and first pose before that stage's clip; do not preclip a Fill placement.
Use shared context collection caps, with renderer-specific dimension and cumulative numerical checks.
Keep omitted legacy Repeat gaps optional while rejecting modern context fields, including null and escaped keys.
Keep numeric fields out of TargetPicker focus cycling so Tab followed by a digit or f stays routable.
Correct four fixture fields accidentally placed on AssetRecord rather than HoldRecipe.
limits: Code review does not establish actual Metal execution, native focus or visual quality.
Generated-media preview, arbitrary nested pause insertion, saved Camera targets and the remaining full specification stay open.
